However, the pressure from the home side was relentless. In the 34th minute, André found the net from close range with a header, expertly assisted by Yerson Mosquera following a corner. The game was effectively put beyond doubt just before the break when Fer López converted a left-footed shot from the center of the box in the 43rd minute, thanks to a sharp setup by Rodrigo Gomes . Penalty Drama and Solid Defense The second half offered Port Vale a lifeline when Mo Faal drew a foul from Mosquera in the box at the 54-minute mark. However, the resulting penalty was brilliantly saved by Dan Bentley , who stood tall to deny Faal ’s central effort. That moment seemed to deflate the visitors' hopes of a comeback as the hosts began to manage the clock and introduce fresh legs. Substitutions followed, with Raúl Jiménez and Tommy Doyle entering the fray for the Wolverhampton Wanderers . While Port Vale ’s Oliver Lynch and Ben Waine attempted late efforts to salvage pride, Bentley and the defensive line remained resolute. The match concluded with a professional display from the top-flight side, securing a clean sheet and a convincing victory to advance in the Carabao Cup .
